comment.body: Thanks for including the PowerToys report ZIP and noting earlier troubleshooting did not help; please do not upload another generic log bundle. The remaining distinction is whether the host exits or stays running without a visible window. On the current version, launch PowerToys once from Start and tell us whether PowerToys.exe appears then exits, remains running with no window, or shows an error. This lets the maintainer use the ZIP against the correct startup path.
